overview.name: Thermographic Survey (NETA 100.18)
overview.description: Thermographic inspection of electrical components to identify abnormal heating, classified according to NETA Table 100.18 temperature-rise guidance.

expected_measurements.name: component_temperature
expected_measurements.description: Surface temperature of the inspected electrical component

expected_measurements.name: reference_temperature
expected_measurements.description: Temperature of a comparable component under similar load or ambient air temperature

expected_measurements.name: comparison_method
expected_measurements.description: Method used to determine temperature rise reference

expected_measurements.name: load_percent
expected_measurements.description: Estimated or measured load at time of inspection; used for contextual interpretation only

input: Capture thermal image of the inspected component
Measure reference temperature based on selected comparison method
Record electrical load percentage if available

notes: Temperature rise is the primary severity driver per NETA 100.18.
Load percentage does not modify delta-T thresholds but provides context, since heating is strongly load-dependent.

ambient_air.recommended_action: Monitor until corrective measures can be accomplished
